[short] skip 'runs test'

bolero test -v -run Test -skip T skip_test.go
! stdout RUN
stdout '^ok.*\[no tests to run\]'

bolero test -v -skip T skip_test.go
! stdout RUN

bolero test -v -skip 1 skip_test.go
! stdout Test1
stdout RUN.*Test2
stdout RUN.*Test2/3

bolero test -v -skip 2/3 skip_test.go
stdout RUN.*Test1
stdout RUN.*Test2
stdout RUN.*ExampleTest1
! stdout Test2/3

bolero test -v -skip 2/4 skip_test.go
stdout RUN.*Test1
stdout RUN.*Test2
stdout RUN.*Test2/3
stdout RUN.*ExampleTest1

bolero test -v -skip Example skip_test.go
stdout RUN.*Test1
stdout RUN.*Test2
stdout RUN.*Test2/3
! stdout ExampleTest1
